description: Find Aniq-UI templates. With no arguments it lists the newest first. `query` matches names, descriptions, categories, tags and features, for example "restaurant" or "admin dashboard arabic". `category` takes a key from list-categories, `type` narrows to templates or bundles, and `freeOnly` or `maxPriceUsd` narrow by the price paid now. Each result has its live price in US dollars (with any discount running now), a short summary, the page to buy it on (pageUrl) and its demo. get-template has the packages and details.

locale.description: Language of the texts and page links (default en)

maxPriceUsd.description: Highest price paid now, in US dollars

type.description: Only templates, or only bundles of several templates

name: search-templates
